_doc: WHIRLWIND parts (reaper_whirlwind.glb, 'Reap the Whirlwind': a boxer-bodied robot gripping two long blades in one outstretched fist). World after import: Z up (0..1.65), the body at x -1.35..-0.49 around z 1.4 and the blades reaching from that fist, their root at about (-0.96, 0.08, 1.43), out to +x and down to the floor at (1.3, +-1.19, 0). The blades are their own material (M_Robot_Legs: the author rigged them as legs), so one region claims that material over the whole box and everything else is the Core. enemy_whirlwind.gd whirls the Blades about their root and shifts the model so that root sits on the body's axis. tools/blender/split_regions.py
